title: Koke Extends at Atletico Madrid With Trophy Talk Front and Center
excerpt: The club's record appearance holder commits to another season and sets the tone with a clear message about winning silverware.
body: Atletico Madrid has confirmed that Koke, whose full name is Jorge Resurreccion, will continue at the club for another year. The extension keeps the captain in place for the 2026-27 season under manager Diego Simeone, and it prolongs the career of the player who holds the record for most appearances in the club's history.

Few figures embody a modern Spanish club the way Koke embodies Atletico. A product of the club's academy who has spent his entire senior career in the red and white shirt, he represents the kind of continuity and identity that supporters and coaches alike tend to prize.

After the renewal was announced, Koke spoke to the club's own channels and framed the season ahead around a single goal. He made clear that the only acceptable ambition is to win a title and return to celebrate at Neptuno, the Madrid fountain where Atletico traditionally marks its triumphs.

That framing tells you a lot about the club's mentality. Rather than talking about rebuilding or transition, the captain set the bar at silverware. For a player of his standing, staying on is not about a farewell lap. It is about competing at the top.

For US coaches studying Spanish football, Koke's story is a useful example of the value of a one-club leader. His longevity provides a cultural anchor inside the dressing room, a living link between generations of players and a standard-setter for younger teammates.

It is also a reminder that leadership and demands go together. A captain who publicly sets the target at winning trophies puts pressure on the whole group, including the coaching staff. That accountability, embraced rather than avoided, is a hallmark of clubs that expect to compete every year.
